title: The locus where the fibre-wise associated points lie in a given open is locally constructible
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a finitely presented morphism and a finitely presented module, the set of base points whose fibre-wise associated points all lie inside a fixed open subscheme is shown to be locally constructible, under a quasi-compactness hypothesis on the open over the base. The proof reduces to the affine case, expresses membership in the set by a finite-presentation condition on the module obtained by restricting to the complement, and then applies the constructibility criterion for finitely presented data. Encoding the statement about associated points as a finite-presentation condition is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 7062-7094.
